title: The 6 Best String Trimmers for Thick Weeds and Overgrown Lots
h1: The 6 Best String Trimmers for Thick Weeds and Overgrown Lots
metaDescription: Our 6 picks for string trimmers for thick weeds and overgrown lots, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at string trimmers for thick weeds and overgrown lots using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Husqvarna 128LD Gas String Trimmer
products.blurb: Key specs: 28cc 2-cycle gas engine, 17-inch cutting swath, Straight shaft with Tap 'n Go head.
strengths: 28cc engine holds RPM through woody stems and dense brush that stalls smaller trimmers
No battery to run down during an extended clearing session
Click-on attachment compatibility allows swapping to a brush cutter blade for the thickest growth
limitations: Requires mixed 2-cycle fuel and periodic carburetor maintenance
Heavier and louder than any battery model in this list
Manual pull start each time versus instant trigger start on electric models
features: Straight shaft with Tap 'n Go head

products.name: EGO Power+ ST1521S 15-Inch String Trimmer
products.blurb: Key specs: 15-inch cutting swath, accepts 0.095-inch line, 56V ARC Lithium battery, 2.5Ah included, Brushless motor.
strengths: 56V brushless motor holds line speed noticeably better than 40V competitors under thick growth
Accepts 0.095-inch line, thick enough for woody weeds without stalling
Runtime on the included 2.5Ah battery is adequate for a typical overgrown-patch session
limitations: Larger battery packs (5.0Ah or more) cost extra and are sold separately
Still not a substitute for a brush cutter blade on truly woody brush
56V battery doesn't interchange with more common 40V tool lines

products.name: Greenworks 40V 12-Inch Cordless String Trimmer
products.blurb: Key specs: 12-inch cutting swath, 40V lithium battery, 2.0Ah included, Dual line auto-feed.
strengths: Handles moderate weeds and overgrown grass reasonably well for the price
Variable speed trigger lets you dial up power only when needed, saving battery
3-year warranty is longer than most trimmers at this price point
limitations: 2.0Ah battery bogs down noticeably faster than 4.0Ah or larger packs in dense material
12-inch swath and narrower line struggle with truly woody stems
Not a realistic substitute for a gas trimmer on genuinely overgrown lots

products.name: Worx WG183 40V String Trimmer
products.blurb: Key specs: 13-inch dual-exit cutting head, 40V PowerShare, 2 x 2.0Ah batteries included, Auto-feed line advance.
strengths: Two batteries extend total runtime across a larger overgrown area
Light weight reduces fatigue compared with heavier gas trimmers on long clearing sessions
Dual-exit head keeps decent cutting efficiency for grass and light weeds
limitations: Least motor torque in this list, struggles once growth turns genuinely woody
13-inch swath means more passes across a large overgrown lot
Not designed for brush-cutter blade attachments

products.name: EGO Power+ ST1511T 15" Cordless String Trimmer
strengths: Gas-like power for thick weeds
PowerLoad winds line automatically
Telescopic shaft
Battery and charger included

products.name: EGO POWER+ ST1610T 16" String Trimmer (Tool Only)
strengths: POWERLOAD winds line automatically
Light carbon fiber telescopic shaft
Strong 56V power
16-inch cutting swath

howWeChose: Picks are based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. We don't claim our own testing.
We do not list prices or star ratings because they change. Check Amazon for current details.
